name: Wind Grappler
body:
The very air aids you when you attempting a combat maneuver.

Prerequisite(s): Air, Cloud or Wind Domain; Channel energy class feature

Benefit(s): You can, as a swift action, utilize one of your uses of channel energy to grant yourself a divine bonus to CMB and CMD for one round. The bonus is equal to twice the number of dice you would normally roll when channeling energy (1d6 equals +2 bonus, 2d6 equals +4 bonus, etc.).
